# aws-github-oidc-scoped-role

> Configure GitHub Actions OIDC trust in AWS IAM using audience and exact subject conditions, including custom subjects for reusable workflows, Bedrock inference-profile permissions and explicit Deny guardrails. Use when designing or reviewing AWS roles assumed by GitHub Actions.

## Install

### APM (recommended)

```bash
apm install mizchi/skills/aws-github-oidc-scoped-role
```

Or declare it in `apm.yml` for a reproducible setup:

```yaml

  apm:
    - mizchi/skills/aws-github-oidc-scoped-role
```

then run `apm install`.
